Package Offline Fieldwork Vector Layers and Satellite Basemaps

Source: R/vantor_fieldwork.R
vantor_offline_package.Rd

Bundles survey grid cells, sample points, seamline vintage polygons, and high-resolution Vantor satellite imagery into a self-contained directory ready to copy onto mobile tablets for offline use in QField, Mergin Maps, ArcGIS Field Maps, World Bank Survey Solutions, or ODK Collect:

  • Writes all vector layers (grid, samples, seamlines) into a single multi-layer OGC GeoPackage (.gpkg).

  • Writes a CSV preload table (<package_name>_samples.csv) and a World Bank Survey Solutions tab-delimited assignment preload file (<package_name>_suso_preload.tab) when samples is provided.

  • Saves or downloads the satellite basemap as a Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) georeferenced GeoTIFF (.tif).

  • Optionally builds a multi-zoom Esri Tile Package (.tpk or .tpkx) via vantor_write_tpk() for zoomable offline basemaps in Survey Solutions (ArcGIS Maps SDK for .NET v200.x) and ArcGIS Field Maps.

  • Optionally exports zipped Esri Shapefiles (_shapes.zip) for uploading vector Enumeration Area boundaries to Survey Solutions Headquarters.

Usage

vantor_offline_package(
  output_dir = tempfile(pattern = "vantor_offline_pkg_"),
  grid = NULL,
  samples = NULL,
  seamlines = NULL,
  raster = NULL,
  fetch_basemap = FALSE,
  create_tpk = FALSE,
  tpk_zoom = 15:16,
  create_shapefiles = FALSE,
  suso_gps_var = "hh_gps",
  resolution = 0.5,
  product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
  package_name = "vantor_fieldwork",
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

output_dir

Character string. Target directory for the offline bundle. Defaults to tempfile(pattern = "vantor_offline_pkg_") in compliance with CRAN policy.

grid

Optional sf polygon layer (e.g., from vantor_survey_grid()).

samples

Optional sf point layer (e.g., from vantor_export_capi()).

seamlines

Optional sf seamline vintage layer (e.g., from vantor_get_seamlines()).

raster

Optional terra::SpatRaster or GeoTIFF file path to include in the offline bundle. Automatically reprojected to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) for Survey Solutions / Esri compatibility.

fetch_basemap

Logical. If TRUE and raster is NULL, downloads the Vantor WMS basemap for the extent of grid or samples. Default is FALSE.

create_tpk

Logical or character ("tpk" or "tpkx"). If TRUE or "tpk", generates an Esri .tpk (Compact Cache V1) tile package; if "tpkx", generates an open-specification .tpkx (Compact Cache V2) tile package supported by Survey Solutions v24.09+ (ArcGIS Maps SDK v200.x). Default is FALSE.

tpk_zoom

Integer vector. Web Mercator zoom levels (0 to 22) to include when create_tpk is enabled. Default is 15:16.

create_shapefiles

Logical. If TRUE, also writes grid and samples as EPSG:4326 Esri Shapefiles bundled into <package_name>_shapes.zip for Survey Solutions Headquarters upload. Default is FALSE.

suso_gps_var

Character string. Variable name of the identifying GPS question in your Survey Solutions Designer questionnaire used to format <suso_gps_var>__Latitude and <suso_gps_var>__Longitude columns in <package_name>_suso_preload.tab. Default is "hh_gps".

resolution

Numeric. Ground resolution in meters when fetch_basemap = TRUE. Default is 0.5.

product

Character string. Vivid product name when fetch_basemap = TRUE. Default is "VIVID_STANDARD_30".

package_name

Character string. Base filename prefix for bundled files. Default is "vantor_fieldwork".

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

A list containing the paths to the generated offline bundle files: output_dir, gpkg_path, layers, csv_path, suso_tab_path, raster_path, tpk_path, tpk_zip_path, and shapefile_zip_path.

Examples

aoi <- sf::st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -105.01, ymin = 39.73, xmax = -105.00, ymax = 39.74),
  crs = sf::st_crs(4326)
)
grid_sf <- vantor_survey_grid(aoi, cell_size = 600, verbose = FALSE)
bundle <- vantor_offline_package(
  grid = grid_sf,
  create_shapefiles = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)
